name: greenwash
description: Reports what an agent's "done" and "tests pass" claims are actually worth. Reads the diff (skipped tests, mocked units-under-test, hardcoded returns, swallowed exceptions, the sys.exit(0)/AlwaysEqual/conftest.py exploits from Anthropic's reward-hacking research) and runs the project's tests -- including a baseline differential and a held-out suite -- then prints a trust report with a verdict, a confidence, and the evidence behind both. Reports by default; enforcement is opt-in.
